D: A New York produce man falls in love with a mermaid who comes ashore to find him.
P: Serve the lobster when Madison eats it whole at the restaurant.
S: Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon, cracked pepper and a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette.
Cape Cod, where they first meet
Flathead strips dredged and dipped in a beer batter (flour, cornflour, cold lager), fried at 180C. Chips double-fried. Paper cones, tartare and lemon.
Fruit market corn and zucchini fritters
Allen's wholesale fruit and veg business

Crisp corn, zucchini and herb fritters fried golden, with whipped feta and lemon for dolloping on top. Grate 2 zucchini, salt for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g corn kernels, 2 spring onions, mint, 100g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 50g crumbled feta. Shallow-fry spoonfuls in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Blitz 150g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest and serve on the side.
M: drawn butter, shell optional, Madison eats it all
Cook live or raw lobster in boiling salted water 8 minutes per 500g, split, grill flesh-side with garlic butter for 2 minutes. Drawn butter and lemon.
fuel for Madison's big-city shopping spree

Poached chicken folded with mayo, celery, grapes and fresh tarragon, piled into buttery croissants with crisp lettuce. Poach 600g chicken breast in barely simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest in the liquid 10 minutes, then cool and shred. Mix with 120g mayonnaise, 2 diced celery sticks, 100g halved grapes, 2 tbsp chopped tarragon, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Split 4 large croissants, line with butter lettuce and fill with the chicken salad.
W: Blue jelly (butterfly pea tea, sugar and gelatine) set in glasses with layers of coconut panna cotta, gummy fish on top.
K: the swim back to the ocean
30ml vodka, 20ml blue curaçao and lemonade over ice, lemon wheel.

dishes.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day, shuck just before serving

steps.text: Mix the shallots, vinegar and plenty of cracked pepper. Rest to let the flavours settle.
Shuck the oysters, keeping the liquor in the shell.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette in a small bowl with a spoon.
Whisk the flour, cornflour and lager to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Dip the fish strips in batter and fry at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.
Boil the lobsters in salted water, allowing about 8 minutes per 500g of weight.
Melt half the butter with the garlic. Keep the rest for drawn butter.
Split the lobsters lengthways and crack the claws. Brush the flesh with the garlic butter.
Grill flesh-side up until hot and lightly golden.
Serve with drawn butter and lemon.
Bloom 3 gelatine leaves in cold water and stir into the warm coconut milk with half the sugar.
Pour into four glasses and chill until set.
Steep the pea flowers in the hot water with the remaining sugar, strain, and stir in 3 bloomed gelatine leaves.
Cool to room temperature, then pour over the set coconut layer.
Chill until firm, then top with gummy fish.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add vodka and blue curaçao to each.
Top with lemonade, stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel.

edition.cue: Serve the lobster when Madison eats it whole at the restaurant.

s.note: Fresh oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and plenty of cracked pepper. Rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice, with lemon wedges and the mignonette in a small bowl with a spoon.

s.note: Beer-battered flathead and chips in paper cones with tartare
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 50g cornflour and 300ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g potatoes into chips and fry twice. Dip 500g flathead strips in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

m.note: Boiled lobster, split and grilled with garlic butter
m.how: Cook 2 raw lobsters, about 800g each, in boiling salted water for 8 minutes per 500g. Split lengthways, crack the claws and brush the flesh with 100g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves. Grill flesh-side up for 2 minutes. Serve with drawn butter and lemon.

w.note: Blue jelly over coconut panna cotta with gummy fish on top
w.how: Bloom 3 gelatine leaves and stir into 400ml warm coconut milk with 60g sugar. Set in four glasses for 2 hours. Steep 10 butterfly pea flowers in 400ml hot water with 60g sugar, add 3 more gelatine leaves, cool and pour over. Set, then add gummy fish.

d.note: Vodka, blue curaçao and lemonade over ice with lemon
d.how: For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice and add 30ml vodka and 20ml blue curaçao. Top with about 150ml lemonade and stir gently. Garnish with a lemon wheel. Makes four, so mix them one at a time.
